en-US: System information now identifies whether a self-hosted Docker deployment is running the official EdgeEver image or a custom image, making support diagnostics clearer.
Windows Preview now launches the packaged interface reliably, avoids a missing Visual C++ runtime dependency, and shows actionable diagnostics instead of a silent white screen when startup fails.
zh-CN: 系统信息现在会标识 Docker 自托管部署使用的是 EdgeEver 官方镜像还是自定义镜像，便于排查部署问题。
Windows 预览版现在可以可靠启动打包界面，不再依赖缺失的 Visual C++ 运行库；启动失败时会显示可操作的诊断信息，而不是无提示白屏。
